verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior findings by narrowing the amendment consistently: the main record now repeatedly and explicitly identifies L1 as only a prerequisite/compiler-mechanism fixture, states that it cannot regress the patched BoundedVec::push path, leaves the real-path guard unspecified and open, and records L2 as non-verdict-producing until its dependent-witness problem is solved. The companion program now makes the same distinction and no longer claims that section 5 completes the missing BoundedVec regression-test specification. The proposed L1 matrix is non-vacuous as a specification because it requires honest and forged-in-range acceptance in addition to forged-out-of-range rejection, while the text remains appropriately research-grade, unexecuted, and non-measurement-bearing. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction was detected in the diff.
